# OpenAI Grant Programs

> > OpenAI's grant and access programs providing API credits, research funding, and specialized tools for AGI research and AI safety.

This portal hosts OpenAI's various grant programs and researcher access initiatives, including subsidized API credits for academic research and specialized access to tools like the DALL·E Detection Classifier for identifying AI-generated content.

## Key Topics

- OpenAI API credits
- AGI research funding
- Researcher Access Program
- DALL·E Detection Classifier
- AI-generated content detection
- Research grants
- API access programs
- Artificial general intelligence
- AI safety research
- Image classification
- Academic research support
- Grant applications
- Subsidized API access

## Program Overview

- [OpenAI Grant Programs Homepage](https://openai.smapply.org/): Main portal for OpenAI grant programs offering AGI research funding and API credits to researchers and organizations

## Research Access Programs

- [OpenAI Researcher Access Program](https://openai.smapply.org/prog/openai_researcher_access_program/): Subsidized OpenAI API credits program for academic researchers and institutions conducting AI research

## Specialized Tools & Detection

- [DALL·E Detection Classifier Access Program](https://openai.smapply.org/prog/dalle_detection_classifier_access_program/): Access program for DALL·E Detection Classifier API to identify and classify AI-generated images
